Body: continuing paragraph, then centred heading "CONCLUSIO NOSTRA", then centred italic title, then a paragraph with a large initial E. Catchword "patet" alone at the right below the last line. main_text.p: in re ipsâ consensum inter nos omnes esse; & tantùm diversitatem in modo ex-plicandi quantum hactenus quidem po-tui intelligere, aut vehementer fallor.

Deus omnium Magistratuum animos di-rigat, ut potestate suâ ita utantur, quò manifestum fiat eos quærere regnum Dei, conservationem Reformatæ Religionis, vigorem denique pietatis, ad gloriam nominis ipsius, Ecclesiæ defensionem, ac Reip. prosperitatem.
main_text.head: CONCLUSIO NOSTRA

head.i: In quâ hæc doctrina à calumniis Pontificiorum vindicatur.

main_text.p: Exposuimus hactenus doctrinam Ecclesiarum Reformatarum de potestate Magistratus in rebus Ecclesia-sticis, prout eam semper, libenter ac liberè confessi & professi sunt Do-ctores & Pastores Ecclesiarum no-strarum, non tantum ante Synodum Dordracenam, sed etiam post eam. page.notes: The running head is "De Episcopatu"; the printed "§.XIV" at the top right is the division number, so it is not part of the running head. "Do-ctores" appears in a heavier face that may be black letter; it is transcribed as roman. Some letters in "eam tuiti sunt" are smudged by specks on the scan, but the words read clearly. The long s has been written as a plain s throughout. The ct ligature in "hactenus" and "doctrina" is written as ct.
